title: Deeper/broader peer release claims, artifact identity, and regression-family crosswalk
mode: Primary-source release/issue review with local plan/source-owner audit; research-only plan update
scope: Refresh ACadRust source-release versus published-crate identity after v0.6.5 publication.
Reconcile ACadRust issues #130 and #132 release-note claims and #133/#134 recovery claims with local owners.
Cross-check current ACadSharp issue families and IxMilia.Dxf declared scope to prevent comparator overreach.
Update only existing PAR-07/S8, PAR-49, PAR-14/PAR-26, PAR-126, and existing DXF color/XDATA/custom-record owners.

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project release, README, package documentation, issue, and local source/plan records
method.limitations: Public release notes and issue reports are evidence about the named artifact/reporter, not independently reproduced behavior. ACadRust v0.6.5's full commit was not resolved or built; docs.rs/crates.io still expose v0.6.4. Private DWG corpora and issue attachments were not obtained.

sources.observed: GitHub lists v0.6.5 at short commit 289a616, released 2026-10-18, and reports project test totals and platform checks. The current repository README uses 0.6.5. docs.rs latest remains 0.6.4, so source release and packaged crate are distinct artifacts.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Release notes, project test totals, and a compatibility matrix are not independent coverage or semantic acceptance evidence. A v0.6.5 source build cannot be described as a v0.6.4 crate run or vice versa.

sources.project: ACadRust table, custom-data, and recovery issues
sources.observed: v0.6.4 release notes list #130/#132 among fixed interoperability reports; v0.6.5 notes claim orphan-geometry and bounded-auxiliary-record recovery improvements associated with #133/#134. The issue pages remained open/requested retest at research time; #133/#134 rely on private production corpora.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Maintainer release claims do not equal reporter retest, normative format evidence, or a local libdxfrw reproduction. The #132 DXF-to-DWG writer losses are not directly applicable to this library, which has no DWG writer.

sources.observed: The issue board includes an omitted AC1014 VERTEX subtype marker report, recursive DXF comment/XDATA/WIPEOUT handling reports, and a DWG-to-DXF spline report with an attached pair but no published expected curve/ordered spline data in the issue body.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-version issue reports are adversarial test prompts only; they do not justify importing peer thresholds or treating a GIS projection as a NURBS semantic oracle.

sources.observed: The README declares a DXF-only reader/writer through R2014, identifies several unsupported entity families including TABLE, MLEADER, MESH, SURFACE, and VIEWPORT, and documents AutoCAD acceptance caveats for some output entities.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Useful only for exact supported DXF route comparisons; not DWG, whole-document preservation, or broad 3D/ACIS/native acceptance.

sources.observed: Existing plan owners cover explicit orphan-owner disposition, bounded object-record policy, AC1024+ merged-range projection and literal DXF groups, and separate color-name/XDATA/custom-record routes. R24 TABLESTYLE suppression semantics remain explicitly raw/unresolved.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This was a read-only plan/source crosswalk; no tests or local behavior were re-executed in this pass.

assessment.planEffect: Correct comparator artifact freshness; classify release-note fixes as unretired until independently retested; keep current local implementation order and use source-identity/owner/disposition manifests at the existing composed checkpoint.
